summary.text: April Cromer is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 6, who assumed office on November 14, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says she was born and lives in Anderson, South Carolina.

paragraphs.text: Cromer's career experience includes working as an internal operations auditor with Cromer Food Services, Inc., according to Ballotpedia.
She assumed office on November 14, 2022, and Ballotpedia lists her on the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
